## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      3 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 28 juin 2026 - 1 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Sam Hyland_, 1 sept. 2026, 1/5: "Signed up for 3 months, app took 50e out of my revolut account but message on the app said payment failed. So now I still have no access and they just took 50e from me. Be very careful here and read trust pilot reviews first, something I should have done"
            2. _Isidro Erazo_, 28 juin 2026, 1/5: "These people won't let you cancel the year subscription. looks like the company needs money"
            3. _Jack Leonard_, 20 août 2026, 2/5: "Not great for strength/hypertrophy. This app is so close to being amazing, all it needs is the ability to properly interact with the 'AI' to create proper workouts for muscle growth. Other reviews have pointed out the specific deficiencies for strength training. It is probably good if you want to lose weight (i.e. low weights, high reps, repeated for the same muscles day after day), and the UI is generally good too. It is overpriced but I get the subscription for free with my bank."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      1 avis récent mentionne bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 3 mai 2026 - 17 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Juan Sebastián Sánchez_, 17 août 2026, 1/5: "Used to like the app but since the latest update is buggy af. Can't trust it for runs as it will randomly change the distances I've run or just skip intervals altogether"
            2. _Mark Campbell-Smith_, 3 mai 2026, 1/5: "app crashing when starting a workout. unusable at the moment"
            3. _Simone Rinaldi_, 16 juin 2026, 5/5: "Ottima, app ben fatta. Anche se non dimenticatevi che per avere risultati, abbinata all'app, ci vuole COSTANZA! Edit: sono quasi alla 40esima settimana di workout e le cose vanno a meraviglia, grazie! edit. l'app va in crash al momento di iniziare il workout. app going in crash when I try to open day's workout, pls resolve"
<!--/ir-theme-->
